import json,re
from pathlib import Path
src={str(p):p.read_text().splitlines() for p in [Path('gobreaker.go'), Path('analysis/_probe/identity_test.go')]}
paths=[Path('analysis')/k for k in ('final.json','review.md','summary.md','open-questions.md')]
texts=[json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.suffix=='.json' else p.read_text() for p in paths]
strings=['\n'.join(r['outcome'] for r in value['findings']) if isinstance(value,dict) else value for value in texts]
count=0
for p,s in zip(paths,strings):
 for name,n,fragment in re.findall(r'(gobreaker\.go|analysis/_probe/identity_test\.go):(\d+) \("(.*?)"\)',s):
  assert fragment in src[name][int(n)-1], (p,name,n,fragment,src[name][int(n)-1])
  count+=1
findings=texts[0]['findings']
runs=[json.loads(l) for l in Path('analysis/probe-attempt-02.stdout.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
passed={e['Test'] for e in runs if e.get('Action')=='pass' and 'Test' in e}
assert all(f['test']=='untested' or f['test'] in passed for f in findings)
print(count,'inline fragments verified at exact lines; all report probe names passed')
